name: sistema-gestion-reparaciones
description: Sistema de gestión para talleres de reparación

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npx wait-on tcp:5432 && npm run db:sync --prefix backend && npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run db:functions --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.test:secretaria: npm run test:secretaria --prefix backend && npm run test:secretaria --prefix frontend
scripts.test:secretaria:integracion: docker compose exec -T backend npm run test:secretaria:integracion
scripts.test:jefe:integracion: docker compose exec -T backend npm run test:jefe:integracion
scripts.test:tecnico:integracion: docker compose exec -T backend npm run test:tecnico:integracion
scripts.test:admin:integracion: docker compose exec -T backend npm run test:admin:integracion
scripts.docker:init: npm run docker:setup && npm run docker:up
scripts.test:notificaciones:integracion: docker compose exec -T backend npm run test:notificaciones:integracion
